_comment: Reinhard's last quest, offered once The Beast of the Farmlands is complete. It ends at Tobias at the Wanderer's fire in the woods, who pays, the L9 half-level rule at L5 (the woods' band, like the-lost-friend at the same fire). Tobias's lines are drafted. Reward [PLACEHOLDER].
title: A Lost Shipment

stages.journal: Reinhard sent his farmhand Tobias to deliver a shipment to Dionsburg. He hasn't returned. Look for Tobias in the forest to the east.
stages.tracker: Find Tobias in the forest to the east

stages.journal: You found Tobias alive at a campfire in the woods. The shipment is lost, but he still has Reinhard's letter.
